## SanDisk and SK Hynix release High Bandwidth Flash specification as an OCP open standard

OCP sponsorship signals intent to make HBF a vendor-neutral standard — analogous to how OCP accelerated open networking adoption — which materially raises the probability of broad datacenter uptake and de-risks dependency on individual hyperscaler buy-in.

- The HBF specification was published as an OCP (Open Compute Project) technical specification, adding an open-standards dimension to the announcement.
- The OCP framing broadens potential ecosystem adoption beyond a proprietary bilateral agreement.
- Coverage is a near-duplicate of cluster d3bb2482b33bb89e with added ecosystem-standardization context.
- Open standardization via OCP could accelerate hyperscaler and ODM adoption curves relative to a closed spec.
